description.value: Some in New Veracruz have started treating the intelligence running Paradise as a new divinity. You're not fooled, and your conviction carries weight: you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Diplomacy or Religion checks made to convince someone that an AI's claim to godhood is false.

cinderfall.incomplete: The +2 Diplomacy/Religion bonus is scoped to the topic of the argument ('an AI's claim to godhood is false'), not a target trait -- the same topic-has-no-roll-option problem as the Recall Knowledge cards.
